identity.name: Restaurant name
identity.aboutHint: Your introduction, also used as the description on Google.
identity.aboutPlaceholder: Fresh pasta made every day from nonna's recipe. Family-friendly place with neighborhood delivery.
identity.coverHint: Shows at the top of the menu, behind the logo. Landscape photos work best. Without a cover, the menu uses the default background.

hours.intro: Turn off the days your restaurant is closed. Hours that go past midnight are fine.

address.hint: Shows in the menu footer, for pickup and in Google search.

modes.hint: Turn on what your restaurant offers: customers only see the options turned on here.
modes.noneWarning: Turn on delivery, pickup or both. With both off, customers can see the menu but can't finish an order — and this tab won't save.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: You take the order to the customer. The delivery fee is added to the total.
delivery.pricingHint: One or the other: customers pick their neighborhood from a list, or enter their ZIP code and the fee is calculated by distance.
delivery.noPointWarning: Mark your restaurant on the map above: without the pin there's nothing to measure distance from, and pricing goes back to by neighborhood.
delivery.perKmFeeHint: 0 keeps the base fee across the whole area.
delivery.distanceNote: Distance is a straight line from the restaurant to the customer's ZIP code — always shorter than the actual ride. The map radius is the limit: outside it, the order comes flagged so you can arrange delivery.
delivery.zonesHint: Customers pick their neighborhood at checkout and the fee is added to the total.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.description: Customers pick up the order at the counter, at the address above. No delivery fee.
pickup.etaHint: Customers see it as “Ready in 20-30 min”. Leave it blank if the time varies a lot.

map.hint: Mark your restaurant on the map and choose how far you deliver. It shows on the menu as a reference for customers.
map.mapLabel: Delivery area map. Click the map or drag the pin to mark your restaurant.
map.needAddress: Fill in the street and city in the address above to search automatically — or mark the spot right on the map.
map.delivering: Delivering up to {radius} from the pin.
map.noPoint: No pin on the map — the menu won't show a delivery area.
map.searchFailed: Couldn't search for the address right now.
map.searchFailedDrag: Couldn't search for the address right now. Drag the pin to your restaurant.
map.found: Found: {label}. Drag the pin if that's not it.
map.foundNoLabel: Pin placed from the address. Check it and drag the pin if needed.
